title: LTFRB orders Move It to pay half-billion-peso fine over excess riders
summary: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has imposed a P555.75-million fine on motorcycle taxi company Move It for exceeding its authorized rider allocation.
